title: Campus Cafe Analysis
text:
This website presents the analysis of the cafe on campus. It could answer the following questions:

Which beverage sells the most cups?
Which beverage makes us the most money?


Resources Acknowledgement
I used DATASCI 350 lecture notes from Lectures 10-11 to complete this quiz. I used OpenAI Codex only to review commands and answers I wrote myself, not to generate solutions.
